children.text: Audio is starting (#1533, owner's direction 2026-11-02). Every start the console makes on its own (the boot auto-start, the recovery after the interface comes back, a reconnect) first opens the device in a warm-up: the player's sample rate with a 512-frame buffer, outputs silent and monitoring off. It switches to the player's own buffer once the console has run 3 s with no late periods, gaps or xruns, or after 20 s at most. While the warm-up runs, this strip stands where the engine-stopped banner sits, under the top bar: $bg-surface fill, radius 10, an hourglass and "Audio is starting…". It has no action because it ends on its own, and the device-lost banner replaces it when both apply. While it shows, nothing is heard and the transport is closed: record, play, clear, clear all, undo, redo, peel and edit length do nothing visible and the contact does not light; the cable test and performance takes are refused. If the device refuses the player's settings, the 512 setting runs and is heard, and the audio-refused banner explains it. The 7″ readout does not echo this strip yet.
